title: Lazar given part disinformation in a controlled leak
summary: Steven Greer tells of Lazar given part disinformation in a controlled leak, about late 1980s at Nevada test site and Area 51, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, what he might have been provided was part information and part disinformation and a controlled leak happened,

plain: Bob Lazar is a man who says that in the late 1980s he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada near Area 51, a classified US military base. Steven Greer, a campaigner on alien disclosure, suggests on Jesse Michels's podcast that Lazar may have been given part real information and part false information, as a deliberate controlled leak. If so, Lazar's story would be partly true and partly planted by insiders.
